Dear all,
together with @Filippo A. E. Nuccio @Antoine Chambert-Loir @María Inés de Frutos Fernández (and other people in the scientific committee, thank's to everyone involved), we are organizing LFTCM 2024 at CIRM.

For those who don't know, it will be similar to LFTCM 2022, and the CIRM is a beautiful place located in the south of France, close to Marseille.

More details will follow, but our application has been accepted today! Unfortunately, the proposed period is not optimal: the week of March 25th 2024 (not a typo, in about one year and a half). We understand that many people have to teach in March, but we hope that knowing the date so in advance will help.

Feel free to start making noise about it, and remember that the event is for people who want to learn Lean, no prior knowledge in formalization is necessary (but we hope it will be fun even for more experienced people...).

Dear All,
the applications for LFTCM24 at CIRM in March 2024 are now open here. We hope to see many of you in Marseille!
4 messages were moved from this topic to #general > Visa talk for LFTCM 2024 by Johan Commelin.

Dear all, if you want to advertise the LFTCM2024 on the mailing list of your department (thanks!) here is a message you can copy. Registration is already possible!

The workshop Lean for the Curious Mathematician 2024, will take place at the Centre International de Rencontres Mathématiques (CIRM) in Luminy, France, next spring, March 25th-29th.

https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/2970.html

The goal of the workshop is to introduce mathematicians to interactive proof assistants, a new technology for writing and checking mathematical proofs. This workshop is truly aimed at beginners. We hope to show participants how they might start to formalize mathematical objects from their own research. The main focus will be on the Lean proof assistant, but there will be a short introduction on other languages.

Accepted participants will be lodged inside the CIRM campus (a beautiful place near Marseille). We also have some funding for travel.

Please share this information with anyone you know who might be interested and please feel free to reach out to me with questions. The application deadline is January 15th.
